d: Bihar ke navada jile se ek behad prerak aur garv karne vali khabar samne aaee hai. ek aanganbari sevika ke bete aur beti ne apni mehnat aur lagan ke dam par desh ke do pratishthit philm sansthanon men jagah banakar pure bihar ka man barhaya hai. navada ke aman raj ka chayan pune sthit philm end telivijan instityut oph indiya (FTII) men huaa hai, jabki unki bahan aditi pasvan ne kolkata sthit satyajit re philm end telivijan instityut (SRFTI) men saphalta hasil ki hai.
